description: This bar chart illustrates the average token count for “Reasoning” and “Demonstration” across different numbers of shots. The horizontal axis, labeled “Number of Shots”, displays categories 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 in sequential order, while the vertical axis, labeled “Token Count”, uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 7000, with tick labels at 1000-unit intervals. Each category contains a stacked bar composed of two colored components: a lower, coral-colored section representing “Reasoning” and an upper, blue-colored section representing “Demonstration”. For Category 0, the “Reasoning” bar reaches a value of approximately 6393, with the “Demonstration” component reaching approximately 4133; a red downward arrow is shown with a value of -1952 above the Demonstration section. Category 1 contains a “Reasoning” bar reaching approximately 4341, with a “Demonstration” component reaching approximately 4188; a red downward arrow is shown with a value of -1613 above the Demonstration section. For Category 2, the “Reasoning” bar reaches approximately 4396, with the “Demonstration” component reaching approximately 4291; a red downward arrow is shown with a value of -1040 above the Demonstration section. In Category 3, the “Reasoning” bar reaches approximately 4399 and the “Demonstration” component reaches approximately 4314; a red downward arrow is shown with a value of -1379 above the Demonstration section. The bars are arranged sequentially based on the “Number of Shots” category, and each “Demonstration” section contains an annotation with a red downward arrow and associated numerical value.
